messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2026-03-25] handover/2026-03-25-billing-api: The billing API has a new home: team Dune. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2025-07-03] standup/atlas/2025-07-03: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.
- [2025-02-06] standup/atlas/2025-02-06: Billing-api calls the ledger service for invoice postings, so treat the ledger service as a hard dependency of billing-api.
- [2026-03-05] standup/boreal/2026-03-05: As before, billing-api needs Ledger to work.
- [2025-12-24] handover/2025-12-24-billing-api: Handover: as of today the billing service moves from the Atlas team to team Boreal. Priya walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-03-24] standup/atlas/2025-03-24: The billing API can be released on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: Atlas owns billing-api. Atlas looks after the flags service.
- [2025-10-21] standup/atlas/2025-10-21: New dependency for the billing service: the feature flag service. Billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags; the reasoning is that the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.
- [2025-11-11] standup/atlas/2025-11-11: Deploy freeze for billing-api: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 (the peak season). Observation from the Atlas team: after Tuesday's deploy, search-indexer's p99 latency doubled.
- [2025-08-08] standup/dune/2025-08-08: New deploy window for the job scheduler: on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. Forget the previous Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC slot. Observation from the Dune team: after the marketing send, billing-api's queue depth hit 50,000.
- [2025-12-31] standup/atlas/2025-12-31: The Atlas team noticed that the billing service's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: Team Atlas saw that the billing service's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-09-19] standup/boreal/2025-09-19: We decided that reporting will read from the event-bus instead of querying the ledger directly. The reason: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. That removes the dependency on Ledger from the reporting service.
- [2025-07-01] handover/2025-07-01-auth-gateway: Quick one: the auth gateway belongs to team Cinder starting today. Thanks to the Ember team for running it until now.
- [2025-07-29] standup/boreal/2025-07-29: Boreal planning meeting is every Thursday. Lena Fischer is the release captain for Q1 2026.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21: Webhooks deploy window: on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-25: reporting went to Boreal, not Ember. Team Ember never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-07-22] standup/cinder/2025-07-22: Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Yuki Tanaka carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-07-18] handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-07-01: auth-gateway went to team Boreal, not the Cinder team. Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-01-23] standup/ember/2026-01-23: Team Ember on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-04-23] standup/ember/2025-04-23: The Ember team runs its planning on Fridays.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2: The monthly cost review is run by Yuki.
- [2025-03-14] standup/atlas/2025-03-14: Dependency map update: the ledger needs the auth gateway (service tokens).
- [2025-07-16] standup/atlas/2025-07-16: On-call rotation: Priya is primary for the Atlas team starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-09-15] standup/boreal/2025-09-15: Lena still has the Boreal pager.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The webhooks service is a Boreal service.
- [2025-07-09] standup/boreal/2025-07-09: Marcus picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Lena Fischer today.
- [2025-02-06] standup/dune/2025-02-06: If the ledger service is down, the reports pipeline is down: it relies on it for the nightly balance export.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: Team Ember owns the job scheduler.
- [2025-04-23] standup/dune/2025-04-23: Team Dune adopted a monthly game day.
- [2025-04-10] standup/boreal/2025-04-10: Team Boreal saw that the catalog service's request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-04-22] standup/boreal/2025-04-22-2: Observation from team Boreal: after the client rollout, the webhook dispatcher's request volume halved.
- [2025-07-21] standup/atlas/2025-07-21-2: Team Atlas has moved to the second floor.

Question: Who was responsible for billing-api on 2025-07-23?

message.reasoning:
The question asks who was responsible for billing-api on 2025-07-23.

Let me trace ownership over time:
- 2025-01-08: Atlas owns billing-api.
- 2025-12-24: Handover: billing service moves from Atlas to Boreal as of 2025-12-24.
- 2026-03-25: billing API moves to team Dune.

On 2025-07-23, the ownership was Atlas (handover to Boreal happened on 2025-12-24).

So the answer: Atlas.
